description: Read a metric card: one checked definition of a football metric (for example PPDA), with every published variant under its own ID (ppda.statsbomb-hudl, ppda.trainor-2014 ...), its formula, zone, source and a checked quote, reference code with test values on public open data where it exists, and caveats. Values from different variants are not comparable, so cite the exact variant ID. Use list_metrics to see the cards.

id.description: A card ID (ppda), a variant ID (ppda.statsbomb-hudl), or a metric name or alias (passes per defensive action).

name: get_metric
